scope: Read-only inspection of inheritanceView, InheritancePanel and exact App/types diff against the already-reviewed state.rs/legacy.rs producer contract. No runtime invocation, native acceptance, source edit or broader ownership discovery.
findings: The six ancestor positions and five slot kinds are projected in fixed recorded order; repeated factors are kept per slot and per retained list occurrence. Stored stars are displayed directly, including 0/4/-1, with missing nonfinite/nonnumber data kept unknown.

Absent structured lineage remains distinct from an empty or partial recorded tree; flat entries are shown separately and never attributed to invented ancestor positions. Missing nodes, names, slots and absent arrays have explicit text.
Stored compatibility, cap additions and starting bonuses are displayed directly; no normalization, summation, star clamping or future inheritance calculation is introduced.
The inheritanceComplete boolean is labelled only as completion of the initial choice, not as the selected choice index; retained skill IDs are labelled candidates rather than learned skills.

The React panel has no request, save, input or mutation callback. Text and IDs use JSX text rendering. App only imports and mounts the panel after AptitudePanel using current career/catalog props, so a replacement career is rendered from the new props without retained view data.
All four added snapshot mirrors are optional, preserving older typed snapshots. App/types changes are additive and leave existing request/selection/save handlers unchanged.
limits: This is source review only. Browser rendering, replacement behavior, request absence and visual fit remain the separate native receiver gate.
Unknown malformed retained values are treated as not recorded; this display does not validate or repair source snapshots.
